name: Creative Internet
summary: creative.net.au was Adrian Chadd's personal/community domain (WAIX, Perth WA) with user subdomains + hobbyist hosting; not a retail ISP.

events.details: creative.net.au was Adrian Chadd's personal domain (WAIX looking-glass and link pages, user subdomains such as michelle./nikita.creative.net.au); the homepage was a personal page, not an ISP storefront.
Personal page captured through 2005; site content changed 2006-07 and the domain later 301-redirected.

Prior record described this as an "Adelaide ISP" active in the "SA peering community"; the archived homepage is instead Adrian Chadd's personal site tied to WAIX (the West Australian Internet Exchange, Perth WA), so the SA/Adelaide attribution is unsupported.
